value.account:
CHANGED
- New orchestrator/workflow/resume_projection_integrity.py (audit_scope, ResumeScopePath, ResumeProjectionIntegrityError, validate_reached_call, current_step_is_forensic), call_frame_retry_lineage.py (index_retry_lineage, next_unused_retry_frame_id, lineage errors) and resume_loop_progress.py (for_each / four repeat_until forms, exact messages). None mention receipts or caches, or import migration/retirement modules.
- state_projection.py: ResumeProjectionValidationError, enumerate_resume_slots, resolve_resume_step_id, resolve_call_boundary, CallBoundaryProjection.import_alias, and a projection-owned repeat_until_max_iterations map (lowering.py populates both).
- Ordering: the CLI audits after the root checksum precheck and before observability overrides, session/process metadata, executor construction (observability persistence moved later). A structural-root WorkflowExecutor rechecks the checksum and audits right before its prologue. CallExecutor.execute_call resolves the boundary once (resolve_call_boundary), selects the callee by the boundary alias, and validates after the input/write-root/checksum/bound-input checks but before any callee frame or executor exists. That validation covers lineage, predecessor checksum+audit in ordinal order, and the running member's scope audit. Frame selection uses lineage instead of mapping order, and the completed-frame id collision is rejected first with the exact call_resume_state_invalid context.
- StateManager.record_workflow_checksum_mismatch / record_resume_projection_integrity_failure patch only status/error/updated_at in the raw state.json atomically, so unknown root fields survive.
- Sticky failure: _handle_control_flow returns _stop before goto/on_error and promotes the first diagnostic to the run error. Typed for_each stops without completing the iteration. repeat_until keeps the diagnostic unwrapped. Calls return a child's diagnostic unwrapped instead of call_failed. Finalization failures are supplemental (failure.error null for ordinary cleanup failures, no wrapper replacing the diagnostic). The CLI session close can no longer replace the diagnostic.
- Observability: a forensic current_step (failed run with either envelope) is pending in build_status_snapshot, so it is not rendered "in progress"; monitor, dashboard heartbeat and cursor ignore it.
- Typed provenance: elaborate_surface_workflow takes frontend_kind and the Lisp validation path sets "workflow_lisp"; build_frontend_bundle no longer overwrites it; CallExecutor._is_workflow_lisp_target checks only that capability.
- Classic YAML: orchestrator/import_alias_integrity.py walks the composed YAML nodes (duplicate keys, << merges, repeated/merged sections) and WorkflowLoader reports the two diagnostics with line/column before any bundle build.
- Docs: specs/state.md section "Checksum-Compatible Resume Projection Integrity" and acceptance items 201-208 plus an executable-proof routing line in specs/acceptance/index.md.
- Tests: new tests/test_resume_projection_integrity.py (56 tests). Updated existing tests that encoded the old behaviour: mutation-order characterization, hand-built current_step without step_id, stub bundles (audit_scope patched), the popped-loop-row lexical fixtures, malformed call_frames, adjudicated changed-config (now a checksum mismatch), Lisp-bundle direct-executor resumes (they now need a lowering-schema context because the bundle is genuinely workflow_lisp), and two wcc golden files (import_alias). Full suite: no new failures versus the baseline (47 pre-existing failures; a couple of adjudicated/at72 tests are flaky under -n 16 on baseline too).

ALTERNATIVES
- Storing max_iterations on IterationStepKeyProjection was dropped because it changes the golden projection summaries; it lives in a separate projection map. Reading the max from the persisted frame row was dropped because the current program should own it.
- Calling resolve_call_boundary inside audit_scope was dropped so a reached call makes exactly one call per identity; the auditor reads the slot index directly.
- Failing hard on an absent repeat_until frame row was dropped: lexical restore legitimately restores it from sidecars. A present row must still match.
- Raising on early lineage errors during frame selection was dropped because the spec orders callee validation after input/checksum checks. Selection is tolerant and the strict audit follows.

NOT COVERED / RISKS
- Predecessor 'recursive' audit is one audit_scope per failed predecessor (nested frames inside it are audited when reached), not an eager tree walk.
- Only the typed loop path stops on a sticky error inside for_each; the legacy untyped loop path is untouched.
- Reason/field choices the spec leaves open are my reading: for_each current_index out of range reuses the completed_indices out-of-range message; ambiguous step ids use presentation_slot_mismatch with the real count; the unknown-id check runs before the unclaimed-row check.
- audit_scope receives dict states; bundles without projection (stubs) are not tolerated.
- I did not commit.
value.summary: Resume now audits every persisted identity (root, reached calls, retry lineage, loops) against the current projection before any effect and fails closed with one sticky diagnostic; the remaining spec items are implemented too, with the exceptions listed in the account.
